# Contributing

Open a branch in the monorepo and keep changes within the relevant component directories. Use Conventional Commits, such as
`fix(rollouts): handle missing probe data`, and open a pull request against `main`.

Include the expected behavior, commands you ran and any configuration needed to reproduce the change.
Describe the affected components when a change spans directories. Record the user-facing deployment
in `gitops-config` so reviewers can see the intended cluster state.
